title: Rendering Shadows
summary: Official Derivative shadow-rendering walkthrough for Light COMP shadow setup, shadow casters, polygon offset artifact cleanup, shadow-map detail tuning with Depth TOP, material-level shadow strength/color, and custom shadow maps accessed from GLSL materials.
guidance: Use this article when building or debugging shadows in a 3D render scene.
Enable Light COMP shadows by setting Shadow Type to Hard, 2D Mapped, then restrict Shadow Casters when light/camera geometry should not cast into the map.
Remove shadow artifacts by tuning the light shadow page Polygon Offset Factor values.
Improve detail by framing the shadow map with light Focal Length, Aperture, or FOV and previewing the map through a Depth TOP pointed at the light.
Shadow Strength and Shadow Color on a Phong MAT affect shadows on that material; other receiving materials need their own settings.

For custom shadow maps, feed a texture such as a Depth TOP into the Light COMP Shadows page, access it with TDShadowTexture in a GLSL material, and consider Render TOP Polygon Depth Offset when rendering the map.
